edges.label: contradicts
edges.reason: The NEW assertion (from the Agriculture Ministry) states the farm's July 2024 implementation plan listed 140 dogs, whereas the EXISTING assertion (from Sangkyung Lee) states the farm declared only 20 dogs in its closure plan. These figures are incompatible. Both are from the same source document.

changes.sentence: On 2026-10-02, UPI reported “Lee said the farm had declared only 20 dogs in its closure plan, but he found more than 60 when he visited, illustrating the difficulty of establishing how many animals remain in the trade.”; on the same day, UPI reported “Responding Wednesday to coverage of the Gangjin rescue, the Agriculture Ministry said the farm's July 2024 implementation plan listed 140 dogs.”.
